# Marshmallows Nail Spa — صالون مارشميلوز لتجميل السيدات

> Ladies-only beauty and nail salon in Kuwait, established 2013. Bilingual
> website: Arabic (default, https://marshmallows.co/) and English
> (https://marshmallows.co/en/home/). Commercial License: 2015/3739.

## What we do / خدماتنا

- Salon Service (خدمة الصالون): manicure & pedicure, scrubs, gel polish,
  nail art, nail extensions (soft gel, permanent, party nails), hair
  (blowdry, wavy, hairstyles, braids), hair treatment (Prime, Bio Smooth),
  hair care, hair color, massage, facials, and "Little Princess" services
  for girls. Prices in Kuwaiti Dinar (KD), e.g. Manicure Pedicure 12 KD,
  Gel Polish 8 KD, Permanent Nail Extension 25 KD.
  AR: https://marshmallows.co/services-ar/salon-service-ar/
  EN: https://marshmallows.co/en/services/salon-service/
- Home Service (خدمة المنزل): the same nail, hair, massage and face
  services delivered at your home anywhere in Kuwait, e.g. Manicure 7.5 KD,
  Gel Polish 9 KD.
  AR: https://marshmallows.co/services-ar/home-service-ar/
  EN: https://marshmallows.co/en/services/home-service/
- Party Booth (بوث الحفلات): kids party packages — Marshmallows Dazzling
  World, Nail Polish & Nail Art, Dazzle Bar, Hair Style & Nails, themed spa
  parties (Unicorn/Princess), Dazzle Hair Package, and in-salon private
  parties. From 20 KD.
  AR: https://marshmallows.co/services-ar/party-booth-ar/
  EN: https://marshmallows.co/en/services/party-booth/

## Locations / الفروع (Kuwait / الكويت)

- Agaila branch (فرع العقيلة): Sama Mall, First Floor.
  Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/twbxrtxmAKioHQNg7
- Salmiya branch (فرع السالمية): Salem Al-Mubarak Street, Symphony Mall,
  Mezzanine, Shop No. 12.
  Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZnFvkNcKmTwh4KwZ8
